notes: The 'rentals' half of this category (canopy/chairs/tent hire) is, in Nigeria, entirely company-marketing content — dozens of real rental businesses (Naphtali, Eloquent Displays, SoundsAndMore) with product catalogs, none teaching how to start or run that specific business. One promising lead ('Canopies and chairs rental business in Nigeria; step by step guide on how to start rental business') looked like genuine business education but couldn't be traced to a clear, named channel this round — worth a direct follow-up.
